text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If one is to be a proper Umamusume of the Mejiro family, "One mustn't let victory go to one's head."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It's vital to remain clearheaded and balanced, lest one lose one's footing…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
choice_data_list: I think it's fine to revel in this victory.
Let's keep going, one step at a time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Do you really believe so? Then, would you please puff out your chest on my behalf? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We did it! Congratulations. How wonderfully gratifying!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Right then, let's focus our energy on preparing for our next victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I shall do my very best.
